name: Gelateria Bellaggio
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gelateria Bellaggio in Kufstein!**

Indulge in the finest Italian gelato in the heart of the **Tirol** region. Our authentic, handcrafted flavors will take you straight to the sunny shores of the Mediterranean—right here in the charming town of **Kufstein**.

From classic **Vanille** and **Schoko** to unique creations like **Pistazie** and **Feigen**, every scoop is a taste of pure happiness. Enjoy your gelato in our cozy café or take it to go—perfect for a sweet break during your explorations of **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes.

**Gelateria Bellaggio**—where every bite is a little vacation!
